common.errorGeneric: The request failed. Please try again.

search.label: Search movies
search.title: Search
search.enterQuery: Type what you want to watch in the search box: a title, an actor or a mood, in English, Russian or Swedish.
search.empty: Nothing found. Try other words or remove some filters.
search.degraded: Semantic search is unavailable right now, so these are keyword results only.
search.rateLimited: Too many searches in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
search.understoodFallback: The query could not be analyzed, so it is searched as typed.

footer.tmdbAttribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

movie.owned: This movie is in your library.
movie.rentedUntil: You are renting this movie until {{date}}.
movie.noOffers: This movie is not for sale right now.
movie.inCart: This movie is in your cart.

cart.title: Cart
cart.unavailableHint: Some movies are no longer sold. Remove them to check out.
cart.fakePaymentNote: Test payment: no real money is charged.

paid.title: Thank you!
paid.description: The payment is confirmed. Your movies are in your library.

failed.title: The payment failed
failed.description: The payment was declined. You can try again; the order is kept until it expires.

expired.title: The order has expired
expired.description: The order was not paid in time. Your cart is still there: check out again.

pending.title: Confirming the payment…
pending.description: We are waiting for the payment provider to confirm the payment. This usually takes a few seconds.
pending.slow: This takes longer than usual. You can leave this page: the movies appear in your library as soon as the payment is confirmed.

cancelled.title: Payment cancelled
cancelled.description: No money was charged. Your order is kept until {{date}}: you can return to the payment.
cancelled.notPayable: No money was charged. This order can no longer be paid; check out again from the cart.

auth.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. A long phrase is easy to remember and hard to guess.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Your cart, purchases and conversations from before signing in move to your account.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: Keep your movies on every device. Your cart, purchases and conversations move to the new account.

errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.lockedOut: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {{min}} characters long.

chat.title: Assistant
chat.description: Ask the AI assistant to find movies, explain its picks and help you check out.
chat.intro: Tell me what you feel like watching: a mood, a story, movies you liked. I search the catalog, add movies to your cart and prepare the payment when you ask.

examples.label: Example questions
examples.evening: Want something for an evening with my wife, we liked Before Sunrise and La La Land.
examples.timeTravel: A time travel movie, but not an action movie.

chat.stopped: Stopped. This answer is not saved.

confirmation.title: Your order
confirmation.notPaid: This order was not paid. Ask the assistant to prepare a new one.
confirmation.superseded: A newer order summary replaced this one.
confirmation.expired: This order summary has expired. Ask the assistant again.

errors.cartChanged: Your cart has changed since the assistant prepared this order. Ask the assistant again.
errors.expired: This order summary has expired. Ask the assistant again.
errors.notPending: This order summary is no longer valid. Ask the assistant again.
errors.notFound: This order summary was not found.

chat.fallbackAnswer: Answered by the backup AI model: the main one was not available.

errors.providerUnavailable: The AI model is not available right now. Please try again later.
errors.conversationBusy: The previous answer is still being written. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.budgetExceeded: This conversation is too long. Please start a new one.
errors.dailyBudgetExceeded: You have used the assistant a lot today. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.serviceBudgetExceeded: The assistant has reached its usage limit for today. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.toolsNotSupported: The selected AI model cannot search the catalog, so the assistant is off.
errors.internalError: Something went wrong while writing the answer.
errors.connectionLost: The connection was lost before the answer was complete.
errors.rateLimited: You are sending messages too fast. Wait a moment and try again.

commerce.offerNotAvailable: This offer is no longer available.
commerce.alreadyRented: You are already renting this movie.
commerce.cartHasUnavailableItems: Some movies in your cart are no longer sold. Remove them first.
commerce.orderNotPayable: This order can no longer be paid. Check out again from the cart.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.description: These pages are for administrators. Sign in with an admin account.

catalog.description: Load the seed file or import movies from TMDB. Imports run in the background in the Worker.

seed.title: Seed file
seed.description: Loads the 1000 movies of data/seed/movies.seed.json. Safe to repeat: movies are matched by their TMDB id.
seed.result: Genres: {{genres}}. Movies created: {{created}}, updated: {{updated}}, unchanged: {{unchanged}}. Took {{seconds}} s.
seed.reindexHint: New and changed movies are found by keywords at once, by meaning only after a reindex.

import.title: Import from TMDB
import.description: The Worker reads the first pages of a TMDB list (20 movies a page) or the movies you name, saves them and embeds the new texts. About 4 movies a second.
import.idsHint: Separated by commas or spaces, e.g. 27205, 157336.
import.invalidIds: Enter TMDB ids: positive whole numbers separated by commas or spaces.
import.conflict: An import is already queued or running.

jobs.description: Background jobs of the Worker, newest first. The list refreshes while a job is queued or running.

embeddings.description: Vectors are stored per model and locale. Build the vectors of a new model next to the old ones, switch the active profile, then delete the old model.

sets.title: Stored vectors
sets.empty: No vectors yet: queue a reindex.
sets.confirmDelete: Delete every vector of {{model}}? Using this model again needs a full reindex.

reindex.title: Reindex
reindex.description: The Worker embeds the movie texts with the chosen profile. Only changed texts by default; a full run re-embeds every movie.
reindex.localesHint: None checked: the configured locales. Vectors of unchecked locales of this model are deleted.
reindex.conflict: A reindex is already queued or running.

ai.description: The profiles come from the configuration (AI:ChatProfiles, AI:EmbeddingProfiles); the operator changes them. Keys are never shown.

test.title: Try a chat profile
test.description: Sends one message to the model and shows the answer with its tokens and cost. The call is also a trace in the Aspire dashboard.
test.defaultMessage: Recommend one movie for a rainy evening, in one sentence.
test.noCost: No price is configured for this model.
test.noKey: This profile has no API key.
